En la estación de tren, Anna salva a un hombre de un intento de asesinato: es Udalov. *El Amo* había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir sus ganancias en el tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva es la primera belleza de la ciudad. Hace tiempo que se ha acostumbrado a la idea de que todo el mundo se interesa sólo por su aspecto. Está rodeada de flores y admiradores, muchos pretendientes. El bandido local Zhukov tampoco pudo resistirse a ella, pero Anna se mantiene inaccesible: no le gusta Zhukov. Contrata a unos matones para que den una lección de venganza a la terca belleza. Un transeúnte, Andrei Savin, es testigo del ataque y defiende a la chica. Inesperadamente, Anna se enamora de Andrei. Al enterarse de la aventura de Anna, Zhukov se enfurece. Al descubrir que su antigua amante está embarazada, le dice a Andrei que el bebé es supuestamente suyo, de Zhukov. Andrei intenta averiguar la verdad, pero Anna, ofendida por su desconfianza, declara que efectivamente está embarazada del bandido. Andrei la deja, Anna aborta. Si hubiera podido adivinar a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Zhukov le dice a Andrei que el hijo de Anna es suyo. Andrei cree el rumor, lo que provoca que Anna termine la relación y aborte. Udalov asesina a Gushin, pero antes de morir, este logra decirle a Andrei el nombre de su asesino. Anna, al ver a Andrei consolando a Natasha, la hija de Gushin, piensa que él ya no la ama y, en un acto de desesperación, intenta suicidarse. Su mejor amiga, Masha, la lleva al hospital. En venganza contra Andrei, Anna acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que le salvó la vida. Mientras tanto, Udalov establece en Rusia un negocio de adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros, con la ayuda de la directora del hospital materno-infantil, María Serguéievna.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, quien está feliz, ya que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Mientras tanto, el negocio de Maks enfrenta problemas, pues un poderoso mafioso llamado *El Amo* le exige pagar sus deudas. Para salvar el negocio de su esposo, Anna se convierte en amante de *El Amo*. Andrei recibe la visita de su amigo Vadim, quien está en Moscú investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños. Juntos, deciden atraparlo. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y sus sentimientos renacen, pero Natasha queda embarazada y Andrei no se atreve a abandonarla. Después de discutir con Andrei, Anna toma un taxi, pero los pasajeros, unos adolescentes drogadictos, intentan abusar de ella. En la lucha, uno de ellos muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada. Andrei intercede ante un alto funcionario (el padre del joven fallecido) para evitar que el caso de Anna avance, ya que ella es inocente. Anna es liberada. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú, donde abren una agencia de detectives. Natasha apoya la decisión de su esposo y lo acompaña, pero su matrimonio se deteriora, ya que Andrei no puede olvidar a Anna. En la estación de tren, Anna salva a un hombre de un intento de asesinato: es Udalov. *El Amo* había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir sus ganancias en el tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Agradecido por haberle salvado la vida, Udalov lleva a Anna a Europa, donde ella comienza a ayudarlo en su negocio, sin saber que las adopciones son ilegales. Mientras tanto, en Moscú, la periodista Aline le muestra a Vadim y Andrei un video de su programa de televisión, donde una mujer llamada Olga revela que Udalov la mantuvo prisionera cuando intentó retractarse de entregar a su bebé en adopción. Udalov envía a Anna a Moscú por otro niño, pero esta vez el bebé está destinado a tráfico de órganos. En Moscú, El Amo secuestra a Anna para obligarla a revelar el paradero de Udalov.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna logra escapar. Udalov, al enterarse de que Anna no recogió al niño del orfanato, viaja apresuradamente a Moscú. Temiendo por su seguridad, decide quedarse en la ciudad y le compra a Anna una clínica de cirugía plástica. Anna se sumerge en su trabajo y es feliz. Mientras tanto, la policía se acerca cada vez más a Udalov. Anna le confiesa su amor por Andrei y le pide que lo localice. Sin querer perder a su "Galatea", Udalov le miente a Anna, diciéndole que Andrei ha muerto.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: El amor entre Anna y Andrei renace y pasan la noche juntos. Sin embargo, Vadim llama desesperado a Andrei para informarle que su hijo, Pavlik, está gravemente enfermo. Anna también va al hospital a verlo, pero Andrei, molesto, le exige que se vaya. Anna se siente herida. Aline le revela a Anna que Udalov es un criminal, pero ella se niega a creerlo, ya que le ha dado una nueva vida y educación. Mientras tanto, Udalov intenta asesinar a El Amo. Anna le cuenta a Udalov que Andrei tiene un video con el testimonio de Alexandra, una mujer que trabajó para Udalov en Europa y sabe demasiado sobre sus negocios ilegales. Udalov entra en pánico y empieza a borrar cualquier evidencia en su contra. Vadim llama a Andrei con una noticia terrible: ha ocurrido una tragedia en la agencia de detectives…

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Una explosión destruye la agencia y todos sus documentos. Anna empieza a darse cuenta de quién es realmente Udalov. Este, viendo que la situación se vuelve insostenible, decide huir a Europa. Le propone un trato a Anna: ella le hace una cirugía para cambiar su identidad, y a cambio, él ordenará la muerte de Natasha, la esposa de Andrei. Anna acepta. La operación es un éxito. Más tarde, Udalov llama a Anna y le dice que Natasha morirá en una hora. En ese momento, Anna se da cuenta del terrible error que ha cometido e intenta advertir a Andrei, pero llega tarde: el sicario mata a Natasha y también a Andrei, quien intentaba protegerla. Destrozada, Anna entrega a Udalov a la policía, ya que es la única que sabe cómo luce ahora. Regresa a su ciudad natal y decide comenzar una nueva vida. Con el corazón roto, pero con un propósito, adopta a Pavlik, el hijo de Andrei, para criarlo como suyo.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia terminan sus estudios y tienen una vida adulta e independiente por delante. Los jóvenes se aman desde hace tiempo y con devoción y ya piensan en formar una familia. Un día, el padre de Ksenia, que trabaja como jefe de una empresa de construcción, se mete en problemas. Es sospechoso de blanqueo de dinero a gran escala y en un futuro próximo no sólo se arriesga a perder todo su patrimonio, sino también a ir a la cárcel durante mucho tiempo. De repente, un viejo conocido de la madre de Ksenia, Grigory Dmitrievich, que ocupa un alto cargo en la administración local de la ciudad, se ofrece a resolver los problemas de su padre. Sin embargo, pone una única condición a cambio: Ksenia debe casarse con su hijo Dima, un futuro pintor que estudia pintura en un colegio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Han pasado veinte años. Una familia de un renombrado artista llega a la ciudad costera para pasar el verano. Se trata de Dmitri, Ksenia y su hija Rita. Pronto, Ksenia recibe una invitación para una reunión de excompañeros de escuela y decide asistir. En el fondo, no puede negar su deseo de volver a ver a Piotr. Mientras tanto, su hija Rita, de 19 años, se ve envuelta en una situación peligrosa, de la que es rescatada por Piotr. Ahora él es un hombre respetado en la ciudad: periodista, empresario y editor de un importante periódico local. En sus manos tiene una historia explosiva sobre corrupción con antiguas casas de campo estatales del partido, propiedades de gran valor. Entre Rita y Piotr comienza a surgir una atracción.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de su hija, pero él se mantiene firme: una vez dejó ir a su gran amor y no piensa cometer el mismo error de nuevo. Está decidido a luchar por Rita. Ksenia escucha lo mismo de su hija: ella no piensa renunciar a Piotr por la opinión de sus padres. Mientras tanto, el escándalo de las casas estatales sigue creciendo. Un colega de Piotr, Edik, descubre que su teléfono está siendo intervenido. La persona detrás de esto pertenece a la élite política. Pronto, dos desconocidos irrumpen en la oficina del periódico exigiendo que entreguen el expediente comprometedor, o la familia de Piotr estará en peligro.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Piotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres por seguridad. Ksenia acepta una tregua temporal con él. Piotr entrega su artículo para la próxima edición del periódico, pero por órdenes "desde arriba", toda la tirada es retirada bajo la acusación de difamación. Mientras tanto, Dmitri no renuncia a su plan de separar a Piotr y Rita. Se reúne con el exnovio de su hija, Aleksandr, instructor del centro náutico, y le da su visto bueno para retomar la relación con Rita… siempre y cuando logre deshacerse de Piotr.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia terminan sus estudios y tienen una vida adulta e independiente por delante. Los jóvenes se aman desde hace tiempo y con devoción y ya piensan en formar una familia. Es sospechoso de blanqueo de dinero a gran escala y en un futuro próximo no sólo se arriesga a perder todo su patrimonio, sino también a ir a la cárcel durante mucho tiempo. De repente, un viejo conocido de la madre de Ksenia, Grigory Dmitrievich, que ocupa un alto cargo en la administración local de la ciudad, se ofrece a resolver los problemas de su padre. Sin embargo, pone una única condición a cambio: Ksenia debe casarse con su hijo Dima, un futuro pintor que estudia pintura en un colegio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Han pasado veinte años. Una familia de un renombrado artista llega a la ciudad costera para pasar el verano. Se trata de Dmitri, Ksenia y su hija Rita. Pronto, Ksenia recibe una invitación para una reunión de excompañeros de escuela y decide asistir. En el fondo, no puede negar su deseo de volver a ver a Piotr. Mientras tanto, su hija Rita, de 19 años, se ve envuelta en una situación peligrosa, de la que es rescatada por Piotr. Ahora él es un hombre respetado en la ciudad: periodista, empresario y editor de un importante periódico local. En sus manos tiene una historia explosiva sobre corrupción con antiguas casas de campo estatales del partido, propiedades de gran valor. Entre Rita y Piotr comienza a surgir una atracción.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de su hija, pero él se mantiene firme: una vez dejó ir a su gran amor y no piensa cometer el mismo error de nuevo. Está decidido a luchar por Rita. Ksenia escucha lo mismo de su hija: ella no piensa renunciar a Piotr por la opinión de sus padres. Mientras tanto, el escándalo de las casas estatales sigue creciendo. Un colega de Piotr, Edik, descubre que su teléfono está siendo intervenido. La persona detrás de esto pertenece a la élite política. Pronto, dos desconocidos irrumpen en la oficina del periódico exigiendo que entreguen el expediente comprometedor, o la familia de Piotr estará en peligro.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Piotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres por seguridad. Ksenia acepta una tregua temporal con él. Piotr entrega su artículo para la próxima edición del periódico, pero por órdenes "desde arriba", toda la tirada es retirada bajo la acusación de difamación. Mientras tanto, Dmitri no renuncia a su plan de separar a Piotr y Rita. Se reúne con el exnovio de su hija, Aleksandr, instructor del centro náutico, y le da su visto bueno para retomar la relación con Rita… siempre y cuando logre deshacerse de Piotr.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Marcelina visita a la Madre Isabel para hablarle sobre su relación con Rosa Blanco, quien fue su mejor amiga y ella la traicionó; por eso quiere impedir su regreso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ante una llamada telefónica de Rosa Blanco a Luciano, Camila, ilusionada, quiere hablar con su mamá. El Capitán Torrealba la ayude a entender los secretos que existen sobre el crimen. Ante la brutal agresión a Sebastián, Ezequiel quiere vengarla con Fernando, un Aragón.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Patricia y María Amelia habían denunciado el crimen de la muerte de Leoncio. Torrealba las enfrenta pues quiere saber cómo fue que Rosa mató a Leoncio. Patricia, desesperada, bebe sin freno. Ante su descontrol, el detective, capcioso, duda de ella.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: En las cartas que entregó Henry a Max, Rosa Blanco dice que le arrebataron a su hija y Camila, muy ansiosa, cree que, al fin sabrá por qué su mamá la abandonó. Marcelina encuentra la caja con las cartas y al saber el contenido, alterada, ordena que las quemen.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Las cartas contienen pruebas que incriminan a Patricia y a Fausto en el asesinato de Leoncio. Camila tomará decisiones importantes, sobre todo para encontrar las cuatro mujeres que traicionaron a su mamá. Fausto tiene una grave intención: hay que matar a Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: La Madre Isabel le confirma a Camila parte de los secretos que oculta: Patricia y su cuñada María Amelia fueron las que denunciaron a su madre. Luciano recibe un sobre que contiene la foto de Camila niña, con su vestidito amarillo, y detrás, una mujer protegiéndola.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Las cuatro mujeres que destruyeron la vida de Rosa Blanco se reencuentran en una casa vacía. Camila se enfrenta a Fausto acusando a Patricia de ser la asesina de Leoncio. Otra vez un motorizado le advierte que no siga buscando a su mamá y le arrebata la carta.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mucha confusión en Camila, nada justifica las mentiras y cada vez Camila está más decepcionada de los engaños de la Madre Isabel. Ezequiel confronta a Julia y agrede salvajemente a Gregorio al encontrarlos juntos.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: La Madre Isabel confiesa a Camila pero la muchacha sabe que aún miente. Jeli, su hermanita, sufre por la irresponsabilidad de Fernando, que la embarazó. Max anuncia a Marcelina y Astrid que pronto se casará con Camila.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Who will Brad choose: his wife or girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents express frustration with their twin sons' disrespectful behavior.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there an adult under your roof, eating your food and taking advantage of you financially? If yes, then you live with a moocher! It's time to stop the enabling and start the accountability.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Phyllis and Barry say they're desperate to calm their violent 15-year-old son, Brandon, and turn to Dr. Phil for help. Their requests for Brandon to perform simple tasks such as brushing his teeth or bathing cause him to go into a rage, breaking things and punching holes in walls, and even chasing Phyllis with scissors. Barry says they walk on eggshells, waiting for Brandon’s next violent outburst and that every day he leaves the house worried that his wife may not be alive when he returns. What is at the root of Brandon's anger? Dr. Phil spends some one-on-one time with the young man to determine what’s driving his behavior. And, find out what Phyllis recently found in Brandon’s room that shocked her to her core.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Children accuse their dad of neglect.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One-time high school sweethearts Tracey and Doug started having marriage problems when Doug admitted to having an affair with a transgender female, Essence.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Darcy says that her sister, Jennifer’s, home is in a state of complete chaos. She says Jennifer and her husband, Ralph, have no rules, their kitchen is bare, the electricity is often shut off, and they put their needs ahead of those of their four children -- who are acting out as a result. Darcy says her nephews, 8 and 10, smoke marijuana, play with weapons and recently started a local forest fire -- and that the 10-year-old once wrote a note asking for someone to kill him in his sleep. She says her 12-year-old niece was recently called to truancy court, and her 16-year-old niece is having unprotected sex in the home with her older, live-in boyfriend. Ralph concedes that he’s struggling to provide for his family financially and has made mistakes as a parent, but says Jennifer is to blame, claiming she’s checked out as a mother. Jennifer admits she’s detached from her family, struggles with depression and has trouble maintaining the household. With this family in dire need of a resolution, Dr. Phil stages a no-nonsense intervention. Are Jennifer and Ralph willing to take the necessary steps to save their family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents are concerned about the extreme measures their daughters take to get and keep a boyfriend.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have someone in your life who's so annoying and frustrating that you just want him or her to go away? What do you do when you're co-parents with someone you can't get along with? And, what if your daughter secretly dated, and then married, a man you despise?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Samantha and her sister Sarah say their mother, Stacy, is very successful as a special education teacher and behaviorist, but hey claim their mother has allowed their 33 year old brother Ben to live rent free for the past 2 years, while he lays by the pool. Stacy’s husband, Doug, says he moved out and refuses to come home until Stacy kicks his stepson out of the house. Ben insists he is not taking advantage of his mother’s hospitality and kindness; he is just stuck in a rut.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Statistics show that 2,000 teens get pregnant every day. Moms and dads: Watch this show with your teenagers, because it can impact their lives and yours! Two families face off over who should raise baby Miley. Paige, 17, and her boyfriend, Jordan, 18, are determined to raise their child on their own, even though they live with Jordan’s dad, Chris. Nikki, Paige’s stepmom, thinks she and her husband should raise the child, because they can better provide for her, and she wants Paige to break up with Jordan. Why does she believe that Jordan is brainwashing Paige? The teen dad says Nikki is the one who’s controlling, and he’s stepped up to the plate. Will the families come to an agreement? See what Dr. Phil tells them they must do to ensure Miley grows up in a healthy environment. Plus, find out the 10 things teens want their parents to know about teen sex.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife who just happens to be the same age as Tara. Christina claims Jim was a horrible husband and a narcissist and she was forced to walk away from the family when Tara was just 13. Since then, she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills! She says he is turning their daughter into a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shot in the face, disfigured for life, the former teen victim comes face to face with the girl who pulled the trigger. Can she forgive?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A couple want to evict their violent 31-year-old son, while their son blames his parents for his financial struggles.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meet a “runaway bride” who’s already called off five weddings and she’s only 26! Then, meet another guest who’s frustrated because her fiancé won’t set a wedding date. He's canceled two previous engagements and says marriage "freaks him out." What does the future hold for these two? Plus, a heartbroken woman whose fiancé called the wedding off a month before her big day. Should she wait for him to come around? Find out what every bride needs to know before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re ready to run for the hills! Kelly is a self-proclaimed runaway bride. She’s been engaged four times but says she gets cold feet before she makes it down the aisle. Rick, her current fiancé, proposed four years ago and is still waiting for her to set a wedding date. Kelly believes that most marriages end in divorce, and she doesn’t want to become another statistic. Should Rick wait for her to make up her mind, or should he cut his losses and move on? Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When he last appeared on Dr. Phil, Kip’s brazen and outrageous tirade toward his 17-year-old stepdaughter, Tory, shocked audience members and viewers. But the married father of two refused to back down. When Tory broke down in tears, Kip finally agreed to find a calmer way to express his frustration. Just weeks later, Tory’s mother, Vicky, says the surly relationship has not only gotten worse, the hostility has escalated, and her patience is running thin. She says both Tory and Kip refuse to seek help, and now there is a new bombshell that is making their home life virtually unbearable. What does Kip say is his biggest issue with his stepdaughter? And, will this family finally agree to accept help and repair what’s left of their relationship? Then, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters. One of the girls has run away, and the other feels that he treats her like a slave. Can they resolve their disputes and come together as one? (FOLLOW UP FROM 9093)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Contemporary weddings have turned into five-star productions, with couples pulling out all the stops to shine on their special day. But what happens when the bride or groom-to-be starts making diva-like demands? Mike and Jamie agreed to a small Vegas wedding, but that went out the window when Jamie switched her gown three times, rented a limo to drive her one block and upgraded her engagement ring. Mike says that Jamie also made him uninvite all of his friends and cancelled his bachelor party! Are Jamie’s antics a hint of what’s to come in their marriage? Then, Nastassia complains that her husband-to-be, Richard, is cheap. She says he wants her to buy bridal flowers from the grocery store, have her mom sew her gown and even schedule the wedding before year's end so he can get a tax write-off! Will Richard’s tightwad ways force Nastassia to call off the wedding?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three wives send their husbands to Dr. Phil's Man Camp for an attitude adjustment.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melinda and Amy claim their lives have been turned upside down by a social media influencer and political activist named Paloma, who they say has subjected them to nine months of cyberbullying and harassment. Paloma says they’ve got it all wrong and that she is the victim of their cyberbullying. Who is the real victim? Will Dr. Phil convince these three women to “log off” from each other? Find out in this explosive episode!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles two news stories that have captivated millions. First up, is it ever appropriate to confront your child’s bullies? That’s what James Jones says he did when he boarded his 12-year-old daughter, Chatari’s, school bus, and the video of his tirade went viral! James says some of the students terrorized his child, who suffers from cerebral palsy, and his actions resulted in two second-degree misdemeanor charges against him. CNN contributor Roland Martin joins the show, and he says James should be named Father of the Year for protecting Chatari, who was reportedly hit, called names and had condoms thrown at her. Roland goes head-to-head with attorney Areva Martin, who says James’s behavior was unwarranted. Did this dad cross the line? What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, the disappearance of David Hartley reads like a murder mystery. His wife, Tiffany, says they were on vacation when David was shot in the head by Mexican pirates while jet skiing. His body was never recovered, and Mexican authorities question if the event really occurred. Some people wonder if Tiffany was involved, but she maintains her innocence. Find out why she declined a lie detector test, and hear Dr. Phil’s strong message for her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, made headlines and were the subject of a Lifetime movie called Baby Brokers. The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? Sandy claims her biological parents “sold her like a piece of furniture for $5,000.” Find out what happens when Sandy meets her biological father for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom is supposed to love and nurture her children, but what if she's too involved? Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling, manipulative and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration, not mourning. He claims she uses bribes to control his every move, including offering him $20,000 to divorce his first wife. Margaret admits that she can be pushy and difficult but says she just wants to see her son succeed in life. Is she really setting him up for failure? Does Reed really want to man-up and break free from his mother's grasp? And, is Margaret willing to let him go? Then, 35-year-old Anthony, star of the new TLC reality show Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home and letting his mom, Patti, wait on him hand and foot. How does Patti feel about their living arrangement? Will she ever kick Anthony out? Plus, hear how Anthony's lifestyle affects his dating life. If you know of a mother-son bond that's a little too close for comfort, don't miss this Dr. Phil. Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration. Margaret says she wants to see her son succeed - but is she setting him up for failure? Plus, 35-year-old Anthony, star of TLC's Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father is fighting for custody of his 4 children because his ex-wife is allegedly in a cult.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Craig and Cherie say the last half of their 16-year marriage has been anything but happily-ever-after. Cherie says Craig is chauvinistic, verbally abusive and demands sex, which she admits she only gives him about three to four times a year. Craig says Cherie withholds sex to control him, and as a result, he has become a slave to his anger. Cherie fears the tension in their household is taking a toll on their 11-year-old daughter, who is often caught in the crossfire of their fighting. Dr. Phil challenges the couple to a communication test. Can they heal their wounds and rekindle their romance? Then, meet the couple who inspired the movie, The Vow. Shortly after Kim and Krickitt Carpenter were married, a terrible car crash changed everything. Krickitt lay in a coma for weeks, and awoke with no recognition of her husband. The couple shares their inspiring, though oftentimes heartbreaking, journey of falling in love all over again. How did they find their way back to each other? And what is it like seeing their lives played out on the big screen? If you’ve ever wondered whether love can survive the toughest of challenges, you won’t want to miss this show! This show contains strong sexual content. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, viewers met 21-year-old Bailey who says she has the greatest love story of the century. She says she met Jasmine on social media eight months ago and that it was love at first post. She says they’ve been communicating day and night but have never spoken on the phone and have never met. When Dr. Phil first tried to talk to Bailey, she became insistent that her mother, Ericka, not participate in the show, and Bailey angrily walked off the stage. Bailey decided to come back to tell Dr. Phil she wants to meet Jasmine for the first time because she has something important to tell her. Will Dr. Phil allow Bailey to meet the target of her obsession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The contentious 2020 presidential election has shown that there’s a clear divide in America – half the country is celebrating, and the other half is angry – making the upcoming holiday season especially tricky to navigate. Instead of being a time of joy, celebration and giving thanks, many families are faced with the dilemma of how not to argue with their own spouses, children and parents about politics. Dr. Phil meets a Republican father, who is barely speaking to his Democrat daughter after an argument they had over Donald Trump. Then, Dr. Phil meets another father, a lifelong Democrat, who says he raised his son to be a free thinker ... but never imagined that he’d support Trump! The election is officially over, but the drama remains. What’s Dr. Phil’s advice on how to move forward post- election without turning holiday dinners with family into a war zone over politics? Tune in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says she was instantly attracted to Jason, known as “Tank D.,” one of the stars of CMT’s hit show Redneck Island, and they started dating. But now, Jessica claims the man she loved for over 18 months is an arrogant, self-centered narcissist who cares more about partying and verbally trashing her than their 6-month-old baby son. Jessica says she believes this reality show "celebrity" is not only a deadbeat dad but an abusive, manipulating narcissist who is acting inappropriately with his female fans and firmly believes he cheated on her with Katie, a co-star from Redneck Island. Jason says Jessica knew he was wild from the start and failed to tame his bad boy ways. He admits he’s called Jessica names but adamantly denies he’s ever been physically abusive toward her. Jason says Jessica needs to stop using their son as a manipulative tool, because they are not together. Jason 100 percent denies cheating with Katie on season 5 of Redneck Island, but Katie says otherwise -- and in a shocking revelation, Katie reveals the full truth to Jessica. Will Jason continue to deny the affair or finally admit to cheating?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lisa says her four beautiful adult daughters, Brandi, Wendi, Laci and Tahni, are "monsters" who pick on her, and their constant drama is tearing apart their family. However, all four daughters say it's Lisa who needs help. They claim she's a "textbook narcissist" who constantly plays the victim and has always put men before her family. Who is in the wrong here? Will Dr. Phil be able to bring this family back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: We've all heard of in-laws who don't get along, but these guests say their problems have become scary and even life-threatening.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman attempts to confront her cheating husband with his alleged mistresses.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your neighbors, your friends or even your child's teacher? An estimated four to eight million people in North America are swinging in the suburbs " mostly middle-class folks from all walks of life. Dr. Phil takes you inside the secret world of swingers, a lifestyle where couples swap partners.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A viral video depicting a judge whipping his daughter sparks outrage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman believes she's going to be Vladimir Putin's wife.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In Part 3 of the Man Camp Series, couples fighting to save their marrages deal with family issues, infidelity, and unexpected visitors.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A man accuses his ex-wife and her new husband of killing his children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says her mother, Patricia, claims she is defying the odds by becoming a record-setting weight lifter while simultaneously battling Stage 3 brain cancer. But Jessica insists her mother isn’t sick at all and that she is lying about her health to gain sympathy and attention. She says Patricia has been spinning stories about various medical ailments for as long as she can remember -- and it’s time to come clean. Patricia strongly denies her daughter’s accusations and insists her diagnosis and incredible survival story are real. Why does she claim Jessica is out to get her? Emotions run high when mother and daughter meet on Dr. Phil’s stage. Do Patricia’s claims hold up? And, can this mother and daughter repair their fractured relationship?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with husband and wife, Nathan and April, who claim a woman named Ashley is fixated on their beautiful twin daughters.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every bride wants to shine on her special day -- from wearing the perfect gown to hosting the most extravagant reception. But what happens when the dream of the perfect wedding turns into a nightmare? Janae knows about this pain firsthand. Her husband, Michael, got so drunk before the ceremony that he passed out cold after saying “I do” and didn’t wake up until the next day! Janae attended the reception by herself and spent her wedding night with her bridesmaids at a hotel. Their wedding from hell took place two years ago, but she still tears up at the memory of that fateful day. Can she ever forgive Michael's mishaps, or is he doomed to the doghouse forever? Then, Angela is a self-professed bridezilla who makes no excuses for her demanding ways. She even created a newsletter for her bridesmaids with the rules and regulations they must follow to participate in her wedding! Her sister and maid of honor, Vanessa, worries that Angela's nitpicking will cause her fiancé, Marvin, to run for the hills. What's behind Angela's controlling behavior, and is she headed for heartache on her special day?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rylee, 26, admits she’s a sugar baby and says she has no shame in dating wealthy, married men she meets online in exchange for money and lavish gifts -- and three years ago, she even convinced her mother, Tanya, to join her. Dr. Phil sits down with this mother/daughter sugar baby team, who insist they never have sex with their clients. What “services” do they say these men are paying for? And how does their family feel about their lifestyle? Then, Ashley admits she has had a side job as a sugar baby for years but has yet to tell her fiancé, Cesar -- and she wants Dr. Phil to help her confess. How will Cesar respond? And, reality TV star Kendra Wilkinson opens up about her husband, Hank Baskett’s, alleged affair with a transsexual. Does she believe the rumors? And, can her marriage survive the turmoil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you rather be right or happy? Dr. Phil talks with some right-fighters who can't settle their debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Demi Moore did it. So did Madonna and Halle Berry. This trend of older women dating younger men is called the Cougar Craze, and it’s sweeping the country. Recently, at a New York speed-dating event, "Sugar Mamas and Boy Toys," good-looking 35-year-old men wooed women over 35 who made at least $500,000 a year. Jeremy organized the event and says he was just answering a demand from affluent ladies. Was he sincere in his matchmaking or just out to make a buck? Dr. Phil talks to two women who participated in the event -- Gail, 44 and Nancy, 50. Their experiences might surprise you. Then, 51-year-old Kat says she’s no cougar; she just likes to date younger guys because men her age are set in their ways. She says her 23-year-old ex-boyfriend, Ryon, was loving, passionate and had a much higher libido than older men. Her friend, Nancy, says Kat has a great head for business, but a bad one when it comes to the opposite sex. She says young men just see dollar signs when they see Kat. Is Kat dating down, or should Nancy just butt out? And, Bobbi had an 11-year relationship with a man who was 17 years her junior, but she says once she turned 50, he saw her as too old. She wants to be in a relationship again, but not with an older man. Her son, Nathan, says someone still wet behind the ears can’t appreciate all Bobbi has to offer. Does Nathan have the right to put his foot down with his mother? Do you think it's OK for older women to date younger men? Take our poll!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From the outside, Jason and Shani had the perfect marriage " a big, beautiful house on the lake and three adorable boys " but recently Jason was crushed to learn that Shani's been having an affair with a mutual friend. Now, Shani is torn between her husband and her lover. What would you do?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Sandy and Ava, who confronted their biological father, Frankie, about his alleged involvement in an adoption scam. Sandy and Ava claim Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, “sold” their children in an adoption scam, where they promised prospective parents they could adopt one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Their brother, Dalton, says he was Frankie and Karen’s ninth child who was adopted. He claims his biological parents put a $3,000 price tag on his head and that he was the last child “sold” before his mother was arrested. Plus, meet one of the prospective parents who adopted one of Karen’s children. Find out why she says Frankie belongs behind bars. And, Frankie’s youngest child, Ava, says she was raised by her father after her mother was arrested by the FBI -- but she says she did not have a better life than her siblings. Find out a dark secret Ava reveals about her father, and why she wants him to take a polygraph test. What happens when Dr. Phil offers Frankie the opportunity to take a polygraph test?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Attention men: If you have a child on the way, or dream of being a father some day, you don’t want to miss this show! A little-known law could keep you from having any rights to your child. Bryce and Esther dated for one month before Esther became pregnant. Bryce says he wanted to marry Esther and raise their child together, but Esther says she wasn’t ready to be a mother. When they broke up, Esther decided to place the baby for adoption without informing Bryce. When Bryce finally learned his daughter was born, she was already seven days old and placed with another family. Now Bryce is fighting to get his child back, but because of an obscure law in some states, he has lost his rights as a father. What law did Bryce fail to comply with that even the lawyers in this case weren’t previously aware of? Is he unfit as a father, or is this law unconstitutional? Bryce and Esther’s lawyers give their opinion. Plus, the grandparents at odds over Esther’s decision face off. Don’t miss this heated discussion and learn more about the Putative Fathers Registry!

Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: BFF

Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: Alex y el Mar
programme.desc: Alex vive en una isla y se prepara cada mañana un desayuno mientras Rocco y Lili juegan juntos. Un científico holográfico aparece en una máquina y le dice a Alex cual es su misión para el día: Alex ha de fotografiar un delfín. Descubrirá todo tipo de vida submarina. Después de un rato, Alex ve un delfín y toma una foto de él. Luego, regresa de vuelta a casa. Al final, una voz explica las características de los delfines.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.desc: La Srta. Vanthrax tiene un resfriado y le pide a Talking Ben que sea el maestro sustituto para su clase. Ben esta encantado, especialmente porque los estudiantes van a decidir hoy el proyecto para la feria de ciencias!

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre cómo las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: Boom and Reds
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.desc: The interim-GLORY Heavyweight Title will be up for grabs as top ranked heavyweight contender Antonio Plazibat (22-4, 16 KO) collides with the number two ranked Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (24-2-1, 12 KO) in the main event. These teammates will have to put their friendship aside for one night and go head-to-head for GLORY gold. programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer (29-5, 15 KO) meets Chico Kwasi (41-5, 22 KO). It’s also an important evening at middleweight with Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-8, 36 KO) colliding with Ulric Bokeme (31-4, 17 KO) and the recently debuted Iliass Hammouche (33-6, 7 KO) facing Ivan Galaz (58-10-1, 15 KO). A huge featherweight match-up between the number one ranked Abraham Vidales (15-2, 12 KO) and number two ranked Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO) plus an exciting light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni (41-8-1, 22 KO) and Stefan Latescu (16-2, 7 KO) will round out the main card.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series.
